moat_justification: Legal monopoly NJ transmission and distribution franchise (PSE&G, ~2.4M electric and ~1.9M gas customers) with essential, inelastic demand and a $22.5-25.5B regulated capex plan through 2030 guided to 6-7.5% rate-base CAGR, plus NJ's only nuclear fleet (~3,758 MW, scarce, with PJM capacity upside) and a plan management says is fundable with no new equity. Capped at 6 because the NJ BPU sets allowed returns (no pricing power, affordability-exposed base-rate filing due by year-end 2026), merchant nuclear lost ZEC support in May 2025 and is hedged not contracted long-term, growth is debt-funded (net debt $22,413M), and the gas network faces long-run electrification risk.
name: Public Service Enterprise Group Incorporated
one_liner: Durable NJ regulated monopoly plus scarce nuclear fleet, moat 6/10, but conservative owner's earnings are negative in 4 of the last 5 years (capex consumes ~all of OCF; normalized base -$0.03/share) — Tier F on this screen; guided 6-8% operating EPS growth does not clear 15% and no hurdle-clearing price is computable on a negative OE base.
